paragraphs.text: This document defines the internal operational guidelines and human resource policies applicable to all employees,contractors, and interns working with the organization. These policies are designed to ensure clarity, accountability,and consistency across all teams.
All team members are expected to comply with the policies mentioned in this document. Failure to adhere to thedefined standards may result in corrective actions as per management discretion.
The company follows a hybrid work culture where employees may work remotely or from the office based on projectrequirements and management approval.

Employees are required to maintain regular attendance and mark their availability using the internal attendancetracking system. Leaves must be applied in advance except in cases of medical emergencies.
Performance evaluations are conducted on a quarterly basis and are based on delivery quality, communication,ownership, and adherence to timelines.
Consistent underperformance may lead to performance improvement plans or termination depending on theseverity of the issue.
For any clarification related to HR or operations, employees may contact the HR team via official communicationchannels.
